title: SENTI3NC3.JAR
body:
SENTIENCE.JAR (Early Alpha)
The code is awake. Do not close your eyes.

Welcome to the early alpha of SENTIENCE.JAR, a meta-horror experience that turns the familiar blocky world into a corrupted, unpredictable nightmare. Inspired by "broken script" and glitch-core horror, this mod doesn't just add monsters—it infects your save file with an intelligence it was never meant to have. The game is trying to communicate, but the translation is broken.

Current Alpha Features:

The Sleep Trap: Beds are no longer a safe haven. Attempting to sleep will bypass the standard night cycle and forcefully drag you into a distorted, inescapable Dream Nightmare Realm.

Anomalous Portals: Bizarre, unnatural portals have begun manifesting in the world. Where do they lead? The script is too broken to tell you. Step through at your own risk.

The "Steves": You are not alone, but they are not players. Two uncanny, Steve-like entities currently roam the world. They look painfully familiar, but their programming is corrupted. They are watching, and they are learning.

A Shattered Reality: A lingering sense of dread built on the idea that the game's fundamental rules are slowly unraveling around you.

Developer Note: This mod is in very early alpha. Expect bugs, strange generation, and incomplete features. Or perhaps they aren't bugs at all. Play at your own risk.
